_doc: Prompts for the per-region soundtrack (scripts/gen-music.mjs; ElevenLabs Music via WaveSpeed by default). Edit a style and re-run `node scripts/gen-music.mjs --only <region> --force`, or add a take with `--append`. All tracks are instrumental, calm and loopable, so they sit under the map instead of competing with it.

defaults.negativeTags: vocals, singing, lyrics, choir words, rap, spoken word, EDM, dubstep, trap beat, heavy drums, distorted guitar, harsh, aggressive, lo-fi hiss
defaults.styleSuffix: instrumental, no vocals, cinematic ambient underscore for a historical atlas, calm and spacious, slow tempo, warm natural reverb, gentle dynamics, seamless loop, high fidelity

europe.title: Orbis · Europe
